what: Palette-locked lighting (web/shaders/palettelight): GPU pass against the float64 CPU reference on Chapel Yard G-buffers
source: fixtures/chapel-render.mjs at 192 x 108; the same f32 G-buffer feeds both sides
why: A palette index is a discrete decision. f32 against f64 can flip it only where a ramp coordinate, a warm fraction or a cycle phase sits within rounding of a threshold; a flip changes one pixel to a neighbouring entry, so the bounds are fractions of pixels.
